t: Introduction and overview — UH-60 Black Hawk
name: Introduction and overview — UH-60 Black Hawk — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — UH-60 Black Hawk
description: Introduction and overview of the UH-60 Black Hawk: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The UH-60 Black Hawk is a twin-engine utility helicopter built by Sikorsky, entering service in 1979. It became the U.S. Army's standard troop transport and utility helicopter, with over 5,000 built in many variants — medevac, special operations, search and rescue, and VIP transport — serving dozens of countries. Baseline facts: Twin-engine utility helicopter; service from 1979; 5,000+ built by Sikorsky in many variants..
how_it_works: Wings generate lift from airflow; the engine provides thrust; control surfaces and fly-by-wire or mechanical controls steer the aircraft in three axes.
key_points: UH-60 Black Hawk: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history.
Twin-engine utility helicopter; service from 1979; 5,000+ built by Sikorsky in many variants.
Key figure: Carries 11 troops; two General Electric T700 turboshafts; dozens of specialized variants.
